interpretation.precision: Precision measures the proportion of classified positive findings that were true positives.
interpretation.recall: Recall measures the proportion of ground-truth issues detected by the scanner.
interpretation.f1_score: F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
interpretation.review_mode_note: In review mode, unmapped findings are stored as unlabelled extras and are not counted as false positives.
interpretation.strict_mode_note: In strict mode, unmapped findings are classified as false positives.
interpretation.duplicate_note: Duplicate matches are reported separately and are not counted as additional true positives or false positives.
interpretation.ambiguous_note: Ambiguous matches are reported separately and are not included in precision, recall or F1 calculations.
